OC-NEW-59.rationale: fp32 upcast inside flex_attention vs bf16 changes only attention forward activations; loss difference is small/cumulative, not a clear runtime fingerprint.

OC-NEW-6.rationale: Sliding window size off-by-one affects attention activations only; no trace field exposes it at runtime.

OC-NEW-60.rationale: Missing label_offsets in one branch shifts CE comparison vocabulary slice; loss differs minutely but no canonical trace fingerprint isolates it.

OC-NEW-61.rationale: Pad positions polluted by boundary mask AND failure: label tensor at masked positions changes value but ignore_index handling makes loss-trace effect ambiguous; not surfaced by schema fields.

OC-NEW-63.rationale: Round-down per-source instances shortens dataset; only visible from offline dataset-length accounting, not runtime trace.

OC-NEW-64.rationale: Cache fingerprint missed sequence_length/bos_token_id: stale cache reused — dataloader-internal cache identity not in the runtime schema.

OC-NEW-65.rationale: Expert label one-hot at index 3 vs only 3 active experts is dataloader label-tensor content; trace schema does not record per-token expert labels.

OC-NEW-66.rationale: Attention gate w_g never initialized: step-0 param checksum on w_g matches torch.empty/default rather than trunc-normal. Tier 0.

OC-NEW-67.rationale: CosWithWarmup vs WSD scheduler differ in lr trajectory shape (cosine decay vs stable plateau then decay); LR trace at Tier 3.

OC-NEW-7.rationale: Custom as_tensor truncates float to int — dtype field at Tier 0 reveals the cast.

OC-NEW-8.rationale: z_loss is detached: value enters logged loss but no gradient. Forward loss looks correct; only way to detect is observing zero gradient on the regularizer's source — op-level requires_grad inspection, not in schema.

OC-NEW-9.rationale: alpha decays to 0 and ce_loss is detached -> backward sees zero gradient; grad_norm collapses to ~0 unexpectedly. Tier 1.

M-NEW-MUON-MTP.rationale: Tied word_embeddings on MTP-only PP stage missing is_embedding_or_output_parameter tag: parameter attribute (named-parameter list) at Tier 0 reveals routing inconsistency across PP stages.
